frame: Clamp frame: origin on the square tube axis at the clamp's lower end; +X toward the skeleton's front, +Y its left, +Z up. The enclosure hangs behind the tube (-X).
status: Geometry checks only. Fasteners and clearances are print hypotheses.

tube.source: Fit-tested by the user on 2026-11-03: of the numbered fit set U1 to U5, U1 (18.9 mm pocket) fits best, so the tube is about 18.0 to 18.6 mm per side. Earlier values (13.35 cm, 13.35 mm, 1 inch, 18.6 mm or so) were measurements or estimates.
tube.note: The pocket fits the largest tube in range with clearance per side; the bar takes up the front-to-back slack, and the arms stop takeup_min short of the smallest tube's front face

clamp.note: U around the tube's back and sides; a front bar with 4 x M3 screws into captured nuts near the arm fronts squeezes the tube front to back. The clamp body is height tall; the dovetail tongue keeps tongue_height so the enclosure still seats and locks on it. The screw holes are blind, ending bolt_hole_back_wall before the U's back face, so no screw reaches the enclosure behind it.

channel.note: Female dovetail on the enclosure: slides down over the clamp's tongue and rests on its top; an M3 pin below the tongue stops it lifting. A 45 degree chamfer under the block lets it print without supports.

plate.note: A frame: rails through the Pi screw rows, a spine behind the dovetail block and a border, with windows between. head_seat is the plate left under each M2.5 head.

pi.note: Pi 5 long axis vertical with the USB end up; its components face back

carrier.note: Light frame with four standoffs on the Pi 5 hole pattern, as tall as the Pi's seat in the community case it replaces, so the same M2.5 x 16 screws pass through the plate, the carrier and the Pi into the AI HAT+ spacers

pca9685.note: Adafruit 815 layout on the wing beside the GPIO edge: control header at the bottom near the I2C pins, servo connectors facing out. X is measured from the back face of the enclosure plate.
